tier_should.rationale: Huge US RCT (N>5k), rich admin data, rigorous preregistered null finding refuting priors; clear mechanisms & model. Contribution strong, methods credible, suitable for top-field or marginal A journal.

tier_will.rationale: Null results and policy partner constraints lessen splashiness; likely placed in strong field outlet (AEJ: Applied, JPubE) rather than AER/QJE despite quality. Reputation of authors boosts odds somewhat.
